subject: Quiet-window: Cross-connect validation and rollback ladder
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Amit Rao <amit.rao@enterpriseops.com>, ops-eng@enterpriseops.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quiet-window: Cross-connect validation and rollback ladder

Amit / Acme ops team —

We're planning a narrow quiet-window to run the cross-connect validation and a small maintenance patch on the private deployment that touches the connection handling in the control plane (non-customer-visible). Goal: validate fiber cross-connects and run a patched agent rollout with a pre-defined rollback ladder. High-level ask: confirm the maintenance window below and sign off on the rollback triggers.

Proposed window:
- Start: 2027-09-12 02:00 UTC (evening US Pacific)
- Duration: 2 hours (expected) with 4-hour abort threshold
- Scope: control-plane agent 2.6.1 -> 2.6.2 patch (no model re-pinning) + network cross-connect health checks

Planned checkpoints (we will run these in order):
1) Pre-window: run cross-connect continuity checks from your colo to the VPC (script attached).
2) Canary (5% of traffic): deploy 2.6.2 to canary slice; run KV cache consistency and EMIT latency tests.
3) Cross-connect verification: execute link flap and re-queue tests to confirm reconnection and session re-establishment.
4) Ramp to 25% then 100% if canary is green.

Rollback ladder (triggers):
- Immediate rollback if >3% increased tail latency on EV metrics for 10 minutes
- Immediate rollback on persistent KV inconsistency detected across >2 nodes for 5 minutes
- Abort and hold if cross-connect drop rate >0.5% or packet loss >0.2% sustained for 2 minutes

Attachments: crossconnect-checklist.xlsx (steps & verification scripts), rollback-playbook-v2.pdf (detailed sequence), trace-snippets.txt (sample traces to collect).

Please confirm:
- The proposed window works for your on-call + colo ops
- Any additional approval or firewall window we should request from your side
- Whether you want us to apply stricter canary ramp (2.5% -> 10%)

Next steps: once I have your green, we'll publish a schedule to the shared calendar + a short bridge link.

Thanks,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

From: Amit Rao <amit.rao@enterpriseops.com>

Cc: ops-eng@enterpriseops.com, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet-window: Cross-connect validation and rollback ladder

Soojin —

Thanks for the clear plan. The window should work for our on-call rotation; I can commit a 2-hour maintenance window starting 02:00 UTC on 2027-09-12. Two quick clarifications before we sign off:

1) Version pinning: are you keeping the model-serving binaries pinned per tenant during this control-plane agent upgrade? We need to ensure no accidental model re-pinning triggers during agent restarts.

2) KV cache rollback: you mention KV inconsistency as a trigger — what is the automated surface for detecting that (metric name / alert)? We prefer an observable that ties to both replica divergence and request-error rate so we don't rollback on transient GC.

Also, please include the expected BGP session behavior in the checklist. On prior maintenance runs, our cross-connects flapped after the agent restart and required a manual session reset at the leaf.

If you can add those pieces to the checklist, we'll provide a signed confirmation by Monday. We'll also stand up a private maintenance bridge and provide the firewall window for ports 179 and 6443 during the run.

-Amit
Amit Rao
Senior Network Engineer, Acme Enterprise
amit.rao@enterpriseops.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Amit Rao <amit.rao@enterpriseops.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Sep 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet-window: Cross-connect validation and rollback ladder

Thanks Amit — good points. Adding specifics here (will update the attached XLS and playbook):

- Model pinning: control-plane agent upgrade WILL NOT touch model pins. We only update the agent binary and the control-plane healthcheck hooks. The model-serving process stays stopped only briefly during a handoff; we have a preflight that asserts model pin tags remain unchanged (metric: service.model_pin_mismatch_count).

- KV cache detection: we'll rely on two signals before auto-rollback is allowed:
  * metric: kv.replica_divergence_count > 0 for 2 consecutive minutes across >1 shard
  * metric: request.tail_error_rate > 0.5% AND p95 latency increases by >40% vs baseline for 10 minutes
  (both must not be transient — we use sliding 10m windows and an incident-correlator to avoid noisy rollbacks)

- BGP/session behavior: per Amit's note, the control-plane agent restart can prompt an RIB refresh. We'll add an explicit step to the crossconnect-checklist: after canary roll, perform bgp-show summary and, if session down, run 'bgp neighbor <ip> soft-reconfig inbound' then 'clear ip bgp <ip> soft' only if the session doesn't recover within 90s.

- Canary ramp: propose keeping canary at 5% for 15 minutes with a smoke test (EMIT p99 <= baseline+30% and kv.replica_divergence_count == 0). If green, go to 25% for 10 minutes then 100% in 15m slices. If Acme prefers a slower canary (2.5% -> 10%), we can change that — call it out in the XLS.

I'll attach the updated rollback-playbook-v2.pdf containing the exact CLI snippets and the automated abort hooks.

-Karthik

Thanks everyone — quick summary and decisions so this thread can be used as the canonical sign-off: 

Decisions:
- Window confirmed: 2027-09-12 02:00 UTC, 2-hour maintenance with 4-hour abort threshold. Acme on-call confirmed.
- Model pinning: will NOT be changed during this operation (metric guard in place: service.model_pin_mismatch_count).
- Canary plan: 5% for 15m -> 25% for 10m -> 100% in 15m slices. Acme had option for slower ramp; they accepted 5% canary.
- Rollback triggers: kv.replica_divergence_count + request.tail_error_rate + latency thresholds as described by Karthik. Those will be configured in the incident-correlator alert and tested during canary.
- BGP behavior: manual session-reset steps added to checklist; Acme provides firewall window and will monitor leaf RT.

Action items (owners):
- Soojin: publish final crossconnect-checklist.xlsx with the added BGP step (due: 2027-09-09 08:00 UTC)
- Karthik: bake the rollback hooks into the release pipelines and post the CLI snippets in the playbook (done)
- Monica: schedule the bridge, add the calendar invite and attach the three docs (crossconnect-checklist.xlsx, rollback-playbook-v2.pdf, trace-snippets.txt) and include the bridge link and access creds (due: 2027-09-09 12:00 UTC)
- Amit: confirm firewall window and on-call handoff on Monday (2027-09-06) and post the contact numbers to the bridge thread

I'll mark this as approved in the maintenance tracker (SERV-1234) and update the runbook. If nobody objects before 2027-09-09 18:00 UTC, we'll proceed with communications.

Thanks —
Neha
